Beta release — please send feedback from Help › Send Feedback.

Bug fixes

  • A message that fails to send is no longer lost: it reopens as a draft with the error, even if the failure happened as you quit.
  • Sending two messages in a row, or quitting during a send, could send one twice and drop the other.
  • Reopening a draft keeps its attachments and Bcc.
  • An address typed into To, Cc or Bcc without pressing Return is now included when you send.
  • Right-click actions (Trash, Star, Spam, Reply) act on the conversation you clicked.
  • Delete trashes the whole conversation unless you've picked a message inside it. Holding Delete no longer trashes one conversation after another.
  • "Sign Out" beside an account signs out that account.
  • Changes made on another device (archive, trash, labels) show up without a reload, and long lists keep their earlier pages.
  • All Inboxes keeps showing your mail when you're offline, and lists show an error with Try Again when they can't load.
  • Starring no longer resets the reading pane.
  • Pop-out windows can send quick replies and stay up to date.
  • Someone you've replied to no longer counts as a new sender.
  • All-day calendar invites are added for the right number of days.
  • Fixed a crash on launch caused by an unusual sender name.
  • Widget and Spotlight links open the right conversation when the app wasn't running.

Security and privacy

  • Quoted email in a reply can no longer run scripts.
  • A crafted link can no longer add hidden recipients to a new message.
  • Subjects and senders are no longer written to the system log.

Beta release — please send feedback from Help › Send Feedback.

What's new

  • Edit your Gmail signatures in Settings › Signatures, or add one to an address that doesn't have one. Bold, italic and underline buttons show when they're on.
  • Settings has a Privacy tab, with Block Trackers and Show Blocked Trackers Count.
  • New Mail and Privacy Mode sounds, plus a volume slider, in Settings › Sounds.
  • Space pages down through the open email; Shift-Space goes back to the top.
  • Click anywhere on a notch notification to open the email, not only the subject.
  • Beta testers can activate with the license key from their invite email.

Beta release — please send feedback from Help › Send Feedback.

What's new

  • Unsubscribe buttons now say how they'll unsubscribe — one-click, by email, or a web link — so you know before clicking. Hover for the address or site.
